if (WIN32)
    if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
        add_subdirectory(Windows/Debug)
        set(LIBTORCH_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Windows/Debug")
    else()
        # add_subdirectory(Windows/Release)
        # set(LIBTORCH_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Windows/Release")

        add_subdirectory(Windows/Release_GPU)
        set(LIBTORCH_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Windows/Release_GPU")
    endif ()
elseif (UNIX)
    if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
        add_subdirectory(Linux/Debug)
        set(LIBTORCH_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Linux/Debug")
    else()
        # add_subdirectory(Linux/Release)
        # set(LIBTORCH_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Linux/Release")

        # add_subdirectory(Linux/Release_GPU)
        set(LIBTORCH_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Linux/Release_GPU")
        set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "${LIBTORCH_DIR}/share/cmake/Torch" ${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH})
    endif ()
endif()
